facts.fact: Radio Okapi reports that Kinshasa's provincial Interior Minister launched on 4 November 2025 a project to digitise the Kinshasa population register, with census agents collecting household data into a compilation server, supported by UNICEF among partners.

facts.fact: ONIP's legal expert described the FGP as the single reference for identifying individuals, covering Congolese and foreigners resident and Congolese abroad.
ONIP's legal expert said civil-status events (births, deaths, marriages) feed the FGP after being registered at the commune and reported to ONIP.
ONIP's legal expert said the FGP is the single data source for producing all secure titles and documents.

ONIP, created in 2011, was entrusted with building the general population file (fichier général de la population), and a 2022 decree organised identification and census operations, per BBC News Afrique.
